SELECT PTOOL_ID,JOB_SPEC_GROUP_ID,MODULE,FOUP_ID,JOB_SPEC_GROUP_PO_ID,LOTID,STATUS ,TEST_FOR,SUB_NAME,SUBSYSTEM,CREATOR,CREATE_TIME,ROUND((UPDATE_TIME - CREATE_TIME)*24,1) DUR ,CASE WHEN UPDATE_TIME - LAST_OP_COMP_TIME <30 THEN ROUND((UPDATE_TIME - NVL(LAST_OP_COMP_TIME,CREATE_TIME))*24,1) END STAY_TIME FROM A1_MFG.OCS_MONITOR_JOB_STATUS WHERE SHIFT_DATE = #{shiftDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND ( ( SHIFT_DATE < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND DATE_TYPE='night') OR ( SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND DATE_TYPE= (CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24,'HH24'))<=12 THEN 'day' ELSE 'night' END) ) )
AND DATE_TYPE= #{daynight,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND MODULE = #{module,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND LENGTH(PTOOL_ID)=5
AND LENGTH(PTOOL_ID)=6
AND STATUS = 'PRD'
AND STATUS = 'Hold'
AND STATUS = 'SBY'
AND STATUS = 'Abort'
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME, PTOOL_ID,JOB_SPEC_GROUP_ID

SELECT distinct EQP_G value ,EQP_G label FROM A1_MFG.OCS_MOVE_NG_SUMMARY WHERE MODULE =#{module,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EQP_G IS NOT NULL
AND LENGTH(PTOOL_ID) = 5
AND LENGTH(PTOOL_ID) = 6

SELECT distinct PURPOSE value ,PURPOSE label FROM A1_MFG.OCS_MOVE_NG_SUMMARY WHERE PURPOSE IS NOT NULL
and LENGTH(PTOOL_ID) = 5
and LENGTH(PTOOL_ID) = 6

WITH MODULE_LIST AS( SELECT 'PHOTO' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'ETCH' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'TF' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'DIFF' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'WET' MODULE FROM DUAL -- UNION ALL -- SELECT 'CMP' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'METRO' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'TOTAL' MODULE FROM DUAL ),DATE_LIST AS( SELECT SHIFT_DATE FROM A3MFGYW1.CLIP_CALENDAR WHERE SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') ) SELECT SHIFT_DATE,PHOTO_RATIO,ETCH_RATIO,TF_RATIO,DIFF_RATIO,WET_RATIO,METRO_RATIO,TOTAL_RATIO FROM( SELECT C.* ,CASE WHEN NVL(D.TOTAL_JOB_COUNT,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(D.COMPLETE_COUNT*100/D.TOTAL_JOB_COUNT ,1) END COMPLETE_RATIO FROM( SELECT A.SHIFT_DATE,B.MODULE FROM DATE_LIST A LEFT JOIN MODULE_LIST B ON 1=1 ) C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,NVL(MODULE,'TOTAL')MODULE , SUM(CASE WHEN JOBGROUP_STATUS IN('Confirm','Complete') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) COMPLETE_COUNT ,COUNT(1) TOTAL_JOB_COUNT FROM A1_MFG.OCS_MONITOR_PLAN_SETTING_DAILY WHERE SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
AND LENGTH(TOOLID)=5
AND LENGTH(TOOLID)=6
GROUP BY SHIFT_DATE,ROLLUP(MODULE) )D ON C.SHIFT_DATE = D.SHIFT_DATE AND C.MODULE = D.MODULE )PIVOT( MAX(COMPLETE_RATIO) FOR MODULE IN('PHOTO' AS PHOTO_RATIO,'ETCH' AS ETCH_RATIO,'TF' AS TF_RATIO,'DIFF' AS DIFF_RATIO,'WET' AS WET_RATIO,'METRO' AS METRO_RATIO,'TOTAL' AS TOTAL_RATIO) )
